caption: The drawing depicts a puppet-like figure with a pale, oval-shaped face featuring black, angled eyebrows, narrow eyes, a mustache, and a slight goatee. The figure's expression is stern. The head is topped with a black band and a tuft of red, brush-like hair. The body is covered in a loose, draped, dark blue or black robe with folds and shadows suggesting fabric texture. The left arm is raised slightly and the right arm is bent, both rendered simply. On the chest area of the robe, there is a prominent yellow or gold swastika symbol, oriented at an angle. The background of the image is plain and beige, with no additional objects or details.
title: Hand Puppet - Chinaman
